verdict.rationale: GitHub's first-party docs describe Automations that run the Copilot cloud agent automatically, either on a recurring schedule or in response to repository events such as an issue being opened. The cloud agent works independently in the background, so this is a real recurring or event-triggered capability, not a one-off action. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of automations working in practice, and detailed documentation of how to configure schedules and event triggers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automations let you run Copilot cloud agent automatically, on a schedule or in response to events in a repository.
Set up an automation to run Copilot automatically, on a schedule or in response to events such as an issue being opened.
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
